cited_passage: IRS, "IRS releases tax inflation adjustments for tax year 2026, including amendments from the One Big Beautiful Bill," IR-2025-103 (Oct. 9, 2025) — basic exclusion amount for estates of decedents dying in 2026: $15,000,000 (up from $13,990,000 for 2025); OBBB made permanent the elevated estate tax exemption.
